title: Bad Luck, Nick!
lines: Josh and Nick fish off the dock.
Nick gets a shell, not a fish.
Then Nick gets a thick sock!
Nick tugs and tugs on it.
He gets a fish, and it is big!

questions.ask: What does Nick pull up before he gets a fish?
questions.listenFor: A shell and a thick sock. Two things - if they name only one, ask "and what else?"

questions.ask: How does Nick know a fish is on his rod?
questions.listenFor: The rod dips. It is stated in the story - have them find that line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Do you think Nick still has bad luck at the end? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. You are listening for a reason tied to the last line of the story.
